name: Add reserved stock tracking across 3 inventory functions
description: Coordinate reservation logic across addItem, reserveStock, releaseStock, and getAvailableStock in src/inventory.ts.

inputs.task_prompt: Update the InventoryRegistry in src/inventory.ts to support stock reservations. In addItem, initialize reserved to 0. In reserveStock, verify available >= quantity, deduct from available, add to reserved, and return true (or false if insufficient). In releaseStock, verify reserved >= quantity, deduct from reserved, add back to available, and return true. In getAvailableStock, return available. All tests in test/inventory.test.ts must pass.

acceptance_criteria: reserveStock transfers from available to reserved
reserveStock returns false when requested qty > available
releaseStock returns reserved back to available
releaseStock returns false when requested qty > reserved
